title: ORACLE + GOLDEN cell output (stub)
description: Reference port (verifier-sanity truth) + golden I/O (grading truth) + proposed epsilon. The epsilon is deterministically validated by a gate, not trusted as-emitted.

reference_port_ref.description: path to the frozen, held-out target-lang port (a1). null if promoted-trajectory fallback pending.

reference_port_clean_room.description: true if authored independently (required when source is copyleft, ADR-0010)

golden_public_ref.description: public goldens captured by running the ORIGINAL on public inputs

golden_heldout_ref.description: held-out goldens; never exposed to the task env

capture_method.description: the wrapped capture toolchain, e.g. minpack _gen/gen_goldens.c

epsilon_justification.description: e.g. measured from original run-to-run variance; cites fp-contract pin

exercises_port.description: held-out inputs give coverage that actually exercises the port
